_comment: Curated Institution slug → Wikidata QID map (#518). Slugs match krr_outputs/institutions/institution_<slug>.json. QIDs taken from the English/Estonian Wikipedia sitelink (wikibase_item), not scraped at test time. Issue #518 listed different Q-numbers; those items are unrelated (Klis / Francis turbine / Maritime Academy / TV.com) and are not used. #718: 'qid' is an identity link (emitted as owl:sameAs) and is unique across slugs except the abbreviation aliases mta/ppa/ttja/harno; 'seeAlsoQid' is a non-identity link (emitted as rdfs:seeAlso) for concept-level classes and for predecessor names that Wikidata folds into the successor's item; 'qidNote' records why. QIDs were checked on 2026-10-08 via wbsearchentities/wbgetentities (cache: data/wikidata_institution_cache.json).
